method: Per-business live check: fetch the listed website (HTTPS validity, CMS/builder and staleness signals, booking capability), then search dated public sources for trading evidence (review dates, Companies House filings, food-hygiene ratings, council and tourism listings). Facts that could not be confirmed are marked unconfirmed, never inferred.

records.name: Golf Links House
records.tradingEvidence: Booking.com listing with 155 reviews and 2026 prices (rated 8.8); TripAdvisor listing updated for 2026.
records.digitalPresence: Census HTTP flag is stale: the domain redirects to a valid HTTPS site, professionally rebuilt after May 2023 (Aspect Media credit) with an integrated direct-book.com booking engine.
records.caveats: Rejected as a redesign showcase: the site is already modern with online booking, so there is little before/after contrast to demonstrate.

records.name: The Buck's Head
records.tradingEvidence: #1 of 8 Dundrum restaurants on TripAdvisor (4.4/5); under new ownership since April 2024 (chef Alex Greene and Bronagh McCormick); Yelp entry updated February 2026.
records.digitalPresence: Current, actively maintained WordPress/Elementor site with modern photography. The 'Book A Table' CTAs lead to a page with phone and email only — no reservations system behind them. Update at build (21 July 2026): the Bookings page now embeds a ResDiary widget (TheBucksHeadRestaurantwithRooms), added since verification — but the page opens with booking-policy warnings before the widget, the five menus remain PDF downloads, and the homepage first screen carries no headline, hours or booking action.
records.designTask: Table reservations flow and menu presentation — a functional upgrade concept, not a visual rebuild.
records.caveats: The site is recent and well maintained; a concept must centre on the booking journey to be honest about the gap.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Menus experience at /concepts/bucks-head/menus/.

records.name: Donard Veterinary Centre
records.tradingEvidence: Actively recruiting vets via vetni.co.uk adverts dated 8 July 2026 and 10 March 2026; RCVS Find-a-Vet listed; independent practice opened 2017 by Catherine Savage.
records.digitalPresence: The census URL (misspelled 'vetinary' domain) is dead (DNS does not resolve). The real site at the correctly spelled domain is a 2017-era Divi build with a '© 2017' footer and a viewport that blocks zooming. Re-checked 21 July 2026 at build time: a PetsApp chat widget has been added since the census pass (chat/booking as a floating bubble with an opening-hours popup), while the Book Appointments page still lists only the phone number and email — no form or booking engine.
records.designTask: Modern practice site: online appointment requests, clear emergency information hierarchy, accessibility fixes.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Appointment request / emergency info at /concepts/donard-veterinary/appointments/.

records.name: Mourne Cycles
records.tradingEvidence: Companies House NI064124 active with confirmation statement dated 25 March 2026; listed Trek dealer and Cyclescheme retailer.
records.digitalPresence: Free-tier Wix brochure site with a '© 2014 … Proudly created with Wix' footer; no product listings, prices, or booking of any kind. Opening screen is a collage of supplier logos (Trek, Bontrager, Shimano) with the shop's own name only in the header logo and the phone number as the only action.
records.designTask: Retail storefront: product range, servicing and hire booking, Cyclescheme funnel.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Hire, workshop & Cyclescheme funnel at /concepts/mourne-cycles/hire/.

records.name: South Down Signs
records.tradingEvidence: Live trade-directory listings (nifed.co.uk, construction.co.uk, irishtrade.ie) and an active Facebook page; no closure markers. Weakest recency evidence on the shortlist — no dated 2026 activity found.
records.digitalPresence: WordPress brochure site on a stale core (6.4.8) with imagery last added around 2023 and no online quote flow.

corrections.address: Unit 3, 142 Dundrum Road, Newcastle, Co. Down, BT33 0LN

records.designTask: Portfolio-led B2B site with a quote-request funnel.
records.caveats: Confirm current trading directly before outreach. Unrelated English company 'South Downs Signs' (double s) appears in searches. Held back from concept work on 21 July 2026 until trading is confirmed; the next redesign example was taken from elsewhere in the shortlist.

records.name: Hotel Enniskeen
records.tradingEvidence: TripAdvisor 'Updated 2026 Reviews' and Expedia 2026 listings; 4.4 rating from ~389 reviews; family-run and independent.
records.digitalPresence: The most dated site of any checked: a ~2012 hand-built ASP.NET template (jQuery 1.8.3, ZeroGrid CSS, booking links still carrying 2013 UTM tags, no copyright year), yet with a working Bookin1 engine and gift-voucher shop attached. Day-of-build re-read 23 July 2026 (F1 flagship gate): unchanged — same template, jQuery 1.8.3, hotel code ECS. Full page-by-page harvest taken into src/data/enniskeen-site.ts; the hotel's own searchbox.min.js confirms the Bookin1 deep-link shape (date and los in the hash on /results; no guests parameter).
records.designTask: Imagery-led country-house hotel site, responsive, with Bookin1 deep links — the most dramatic before/after contrast of the ten.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Rooms & stay detail with Bookin1 at /concepts/hotel-enniskeen/rooms/. F1 flagship working prototype completed locally 23 July 2026: five linked concept pages, 60-second MP4/WebM film with opt-in player, Dine companion still, two-page A4 one-sheet and written pitch. Stage remains Concept published; no contact or promotion has occurred. mournemade.co.uk still had no DNS record on final QA, so production request delivery and a printed-phone QR scan remain unverified external gates.

records.name: Scopers
records.tradingEvidence: TripAdvisor 4.6/5 from 27 reviews, most recent 4 June 2026; supper club events promoted via council tourism listings. Local first-hand report (21 July 2026): now open most of the week and very popular — the earlier Thursday-only pattern is outdated.
records.digitalPresence: No website confirmed. The chef's previous domain (paulcunningham.co) no longer resolves, and ticketed supper clubs are sold through Facebook and Instagram only.

corrections.address: 169 Main Street, Dundrum, Co. Down, BT33 0LY

records.designTask: Chef-led brand single-pager with supper club events and booking. It is a sustainable hot-food bar, not an ice cream shop.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Supper-club night page at /concepts/scopers/supper-club/.

records.name: Cupla
records.tradingEvidence: CUPLA BAI'S LTD (NI711705) active at Companies House; food hygiene rating 'Good' on 17 January 2025; no closure reports found. Confirmation statement was overdue at the time of checking, but the café was confirmed actively trading by local first-hand report, 21 July 2026.
records.digitalPresence: No website confirmed; social-only presence and no TripAdvisor listing. Café ('Brews, Bakes & Bowls') founded 2024 by twin owners, with a distinct bilingual Irish-language identity.

corrections.address: 105 Main Street, Dundrum, Co. Down, BT33 0LX

records.designTask: Mobile-first café page with bilingual Irish-language brand identity.
records.caveats: Distinguish from Cupla Coffee (Utah, USA) and Dundrum (Dublin) businesses.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Bilingual menu at /concepts/cupla/menu/.

records.name: The Tool Centre
records.tradingEvidence: Full seven-day opening hours listed on directories; Google reviews praising the owner and prices; no closure markers on ~8 directory listings checked. No dated 2026 third-party evidence.
records.digitalPresence: No website confirmed across all directories checked. Facebook page trades as 'Tool Centre Plant Hire' — same address and phone, two service lines (hardware retail plus plant and tool hire).

corrections.address: 107 Main Street, Newcastle, Co. Down, BT33 0AE

records.designTask: Utilitarian trade site: hire price list, stock categories, opening hours.
records.caveats: Search results are dominated by same-named shops in Newcastle-upon-Tyne — a site would materially help local findability. Resolve the retail vs social naming inconsistency in showcase copy.
records.notes: Build-day re-read 22 July 2026: still no website; Facebook remains the primary public presence (Meta cookie/login wall for logged-out visitors; temporary block encountered from this environment). Big Red Directory still lists Mon–Sat 9–5 / Sun 10–4 at 107 Main St BT33 0AE; Calor dealer listing confirms bottled-gas retail. Concept resolves Tool Centre vs Tool Centre Plant Hire naming in copy and keeps Co. Down / Mourne placement explicit. M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Plant-hire price list at /concepts/tool-centre/hire-list/.

records.name: Kent Amusements

Over fifty years on the Central Promenade site. Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/kentamusementsnewcastle/ re-confirmed live on 22 July 2026 (build day).

records.designTask: Seasonal attraction site: what's inside (dodgems, VR), opening hours, family offers.

records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Attractions, hours & family offers board at /concepts/kent-amusements/attractions/.

records.name: Newcastle Chamber Of Commerce

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/newcastlechamberofcommerce/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/newcastlechamber_/ re-confirmed live on 22 July 2026 (build day); Gmail contact newcastlechamber2023@gmail.com unchanged.
records.digitalPresence: No website — runs on a Gmail address and social profiles. At least eight same-named chambers worldwide dominate search results for its name. Primary public presence is the Facebook page (login wall for first-time visitors on the 22 July 2026 capture; no cookie dialog in frame); Instagram also active.

corrections.address: 50A Main Street, Newcastle, Co. Down, BT33 0AD

records.designTask: Civic hub: member directory, events calendar, join page — a visible community contribution.
records.caveats: Volunteer committee relaunched 2023, so decisions may be slow; officer names are unconfirmed snippet data.
records.notes: M2 second asset shipped 22 July 2026: Member directory at /concepts/newcastle-chamber/members/. Full-site exploration 22 July 2026: research brief + three prototypes at /prototypes/chamber/. Decision: B-led hybrid (Finder IA + civic chrome + warmer join) published as full linked concept site at /concepts/newcastle-chamber/ (Home, Members, Events, Join, About, Contact).

records.name: Painted Earth
records.tradingEvidence: Own website lists current opening hours; upstairs gallery opened April 2025 and store expansion announced February 2025; Craft NI listed; 20+ years trading.
records.digitalPresence: Census 'no website' refuted: a full e-commerce site exists but was missing from the Google Maps listing. It is a jewellery, art, and gift shop with an on-site goldsmith — not paint-your-own pottery (that is The Clay Project).

corrections.address: 98 Main Street, Newcastle, Co. Down, BT33 0AE

records.caveats: Removed from the shortlist: already runs a polished e-commerce site. Data-quality case — an empty Maps website field hid a live store.

records.digitalPresence: Current WordPress site with an integrated freetobook booking engine; menu content updated 2024, footer © 2026.
records.caveats: Site is current with real booking — low redesign contrast.

records.name: Dacara
records.tradingEvidence: TripAdvisor listing active (#6 of 18 Newcastle B&Bs) with reviews through late 2024; listed on Discover Northern Ireland. Softest trading evidence of the accommodation group.
records.digitalPresence: Recently rebuilt WordPress/Elementor site (2025/26-era Elementor), but no online booking — enquiries by form, phone, or email only.
records.caveats: Fresh rebuild limits visual contrast; the real gap is adding a booking engine — a possible future feature-upgrade case.

records.name: Conlyn House
records.tradingEvidence: TripAdvisor listing with 2024–25 reviews; active Facebook page; independent (owner named in reviews).
records.digitalPresence: Modern Elementor build, but the homepage 'Book Now!' button leads only to a name/phone/email enquiry form — no calendar, availability, or prices.
records.caveats: Possible future booking-UX case: the misleading 'Book Now' is the improvement story, not visual datedness.

records.name: Hutt Backpackers Hostel
records.tradingEvidence: Hostelworld listing with 2026 prices and reviews; TripAdvisor reviews including May 2025; independent.
records.digitalPresence: Current WordPress core but a 2017-era Slider Revolution/WPBakery aesthetic with 2018–19 photos — and a working native multi-step booking flow already in place.
records.caveats: Runner-up for the accommodation slot: dated styling but capability already exists, so the demonstrable delta is smaller than Hotel Enniskeen's.
